about: Sylph Industries Limited (formerly Sylph Technologies) is an Indore-registered trading -led company in commodities/FMCG, solar products and construction chemicals. Since August 2025 it consolidates 65%-owned Maxrotth Foods, an exporter/wholesaler of pulses, spices, groceries and FMCG; it also disclosed a 25% investment in construction-chemicals maker Semitrone Conchem.
